concerns: No statistical significance tests, confidence intervals, or uncertainty estimates are reported for the small performance differences over ESM2-150M.
The 80/20 UniRef50/UniRef90 sampling strategy is explicitly acknowledged as not validated through a fully controlled ablation.
Some baseline comparisons rely on literature-reported reference numbers rather than controlled head-to-head evaluation, which limits direct comparability.
The ablation table reports only deltas relative to full ProtLingo without absolute values or variance, making the magnitude of degradation hard to contextualize.
The biological-specialization analyses are descriptive and do not establish causal functional relevance of expert routing beyond the fixed-expert-selection probing.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: ProtLingo augments a pretrained ESM2-150M protein language model with centered latent N-gram memory and sparse MoE upcycling to improve mutation-sensitive modeling at a compact parameter budget. The paper provides clear architectural descriptions, extensive implementation details, and evaluations on ProteinGym, FLIP, and CASP15 contact prediction, along with ablations and biological-specialization analyses. The gains over the backbone are modest and not accompanied by statistical uncertainty estimates, and some comparisons rely on literature-reported references. The paper is appropriately scoped and transparent about limitations, supporting a passing assessment with moderate confidence.
